symptom: Reservoir pressure dropped about 1 bar in 10 minutes with train parked; compressor loading every few minutes.
action: Leak test per M-6.1; found loose fitting on rear door cylinder supply; tightened and retested.
outcome: Drop 0.2 bar in 10 minutes after repair; closed.

symptom: Oil level signal set at depot check.
action: Topped up oil; inspected housing and drain; no oil found outside.
outcome: Level stable at next weekly check; closed.

symptom: DV_pressure stayed above zero while loading; slow recovery after tower change.
action: Dryer tower check per M-6.2; tower B did not hold pressure; replaced purge valve seal.
outcome: Both towers held pressure on recheck; closed.

symptom: Idle periods much shorter than usual; oil temperature higher than other units on the same line.
action: Leak test failed (0.9 bar drop); traced hiss to cracked hose at brake panel; replaced hose.
outcome: Leak test passed; duty cycle back to normal within a day.

symptom: Slow pressure build-up after depot washing; motor current normal.
action: Inspected intake filter; filter soaked and clogged; replaced.

symptom: LPS raised during morning run; brakes slow to release.
action: Train taken out of service; compressor ran normally; found disconnected coupling hose between cars; reconnected and secured.
outcome: Leak test passed; reported to shift supervisor; closed.

symptom: Motor protection tripped once at start-up.
action: Inspected drive; bearing noise on motor end; replaced motor bearings.
outcome: No further trips in 30 days; closed.

symptom: Watch alert on Reservoirs below baseline, repeated twice the same day.
action: Handled as act per M-3.3; leak test showed 0.6 bar drop; replaced worn seal on door cylinder.

symptom: Oil temperature high during hot weather; duty cycle normal.
action: Cleaned oil cooler fins, which were clogged with dust.
outcome: Oil temperature back in usual range; closed.

symptom: H1 opened at a pressure well below the upper setpoint.
action: Compared TP2 and TP3 with calibrated gauge; switch read 0.5 bar high; replaced pressure switch.

symptom: Compressor loading more often while parked overnight; Caudal_impulses high.
action: Leak test 0.7 bar drop; leak-detection spray found leak at suspension valve fitting; replaced fitting.

symptom: Outlet air wet at drain.
action: Replaced desiccant in both towers (over 4 000 hours).

symptom: Motor current near unloaded value while unit should be loading.
action: Checked COMP signal and intake valve; intake valve stuck closed; cleaned and freed valve.

symptom: Act alert, drivers Reservoirs below and Motor_current above baseline.
action: Leak test per M-6.1 failed; found two loose fittings under car 2; tightened both.

symptom: Oil level dropped again six days after top-up.
action: Opened work order for oil leak; found weeping seal at oil filter housing; replaced seal.
parts: oil filter housing seal, oil 1 L
outcome: Level stable for two weeks; closed.

symptom: Pressure drop larger than usual at each tower change.
action: Dryer tower check; tower A purge valve seal worn; replaced.

symptom: Watch alert on Oil_temperature, single interval, not repeated.
action: Noted and compared with last record; no action needed.
outcome: No repeat within a week; closed without work.

symptom: Leak test failed twice after replacing a door cylinder seal.
action: Escalated to senior engineer per M-6.4; found cracked reservoir drain valve body; replaced valve.

symptom: Motor protection tripped twice in one week.
action: Escalated per M-6.4; supply voltage low at depot socket; depot electrical team fixed supply.

symptom: Slow pressure build-up; intake filter recently replaced.
action: Leak test failed (1.1 bar drop); found split hose to horn valve; replaced hose.

symptom: Pressure_switch reported discharges with no pressure change.
action: Checked wiring; corroded connector on switch cable; cleaned and resealed connector.

symptom: Compressor loading more often in cold weather; reservoir pressure falls fast when parked.
action: Leak test 0.8 bar drop; leak at brake cylinder seal on car 1, hardened by cold; replaced seal.

symptom: Oil temperature high and oil level signal set together.
action: Topped up oil per M-5.2, then checked cooler; both needed attention; cleaned cooler.

symptom: Act alert, driver DV_pressure above baseline.
action: Dryer tower check; tower B check valve leaking; replaced check valve.
outcome: DV_pressure near zero during load; closed.

symptom: Start-up current peaks longer than usual.
action: Inspected screw element; early wear on rotor bearing; scheduled overhaul.

symptom: Watch alerts on Caudal_impulses on two consecutive nights.
action: Handled as act per M-3.3; leak test 0.6 bar drop; tightened fitting at pneumatic panel.

symptom: LPS raised at depot after overnight stabling.
action: Train kept out of service; found main reservoir drain left partly open after previous work; closed drain; briefed crew on M-6.3.
outcome: Leak test passed; reported to supervisor; closed.

symptom: Motor current above 9 A after start-up peak.
action: Stopped unit; screw element hard to turn; replaced screw element under overhaul.

symptom: Act alert, drivers Reservoirs below baseline and Oil_temperature above baseline.
action: Leak test 0.9 bar drop; worn seal on suspension levelling valve; replaced.
outcome: Leak test passed; duty cycle normal; closed.

symptom: Symptom not described in manual: intermittent rattle from compressor mounting.
action: Escalated per M-6.4; mounting bolt loose; tightened to torque and marked.
